title: 第15章 药铺第16章 一重境
content_zh:
虚维之眼的范围越大，收集到的精气神越多，维点收集得越快，只要维点足够多，他的实力也会飞快的增长。
想着，易长生打算接下来先将虚维之眼提升了，最少也要提升到6点，全知视角有六米方圆，最大范围差不多十八米方圆。
这样田家武馆前院都在范围内，可以将那些练出内气的武者都包括进来，到时收集维点也更快一些。
想着易长生动力十足，每天都过得很充实。
他先是花了二十多天的时间来将虚维之眼的点数加到了六点，每增加一点，范围增加得越大，收集到的精气神越快，到了六点时，差不四天就能收到到一点维点了。
接着又用了一个多月的时间来全力提升养身拳，就这样不知不觉两个月的时间就过去了。
他看了一眼面板上的信息。
【姓名：易长生】
【寿元：1066】
【天赋：虚维之眼lv.1（6100+）】
【悟性：2】
【灵根：金9、水10、木23、火19、土11、空28】
【修为：养身境（1010）】
【功法：养身拳（入门510+）】
【技艺：厨艺（入门22100+）】
【维点：2】
养身拳的修为终于练满了，功法熟练度还是易长生自行领悟的。
毕竟跟了齐万才学习了那么多武学知识，他的武学功底也增加了很多，对于简单的养身拳功法来说，领悟并不难。
现在的易长生气血非常充足，和齐万才相比的话，还要强上一些的。
按照面板点数来算的话，齐万才大概在8点的修为，以齐万才目前还算不错的资质与进度来算的话，他估计还要练一年左右才能将养身拳练成。

而易长生从穿越到练养身拳，总共也就三个月左右。
他的练武资质应该也算不错，但再怎么不错，三个月的时间就能将养身拳就练成，功劳全归于虚维之眼的维点。
他心里不由得不感叹一下虚维之眼这个天赋太强大了吧。
不过一想到这个金手指是自己的，那就没事了，再强大点他也能接受。
现在易长生练拳时隐隐能感知到气血，甚至有能抓住气血的感觉，这种情况下，说明已经可以正式修练各种强大的武学功法了。
现在就差入门先天功了，他攒下来的2点维点，就是为先天功准备的，等先天功一旦入门录入面板，就可以直接加点提升。
经过这两个月的研读，易长生几乎可以将先天功背熟了，再加上有之前观察过田大小姐体内的运功过程，他相信要不了多久自己就能将先天功练进入门。
不过，先天功是一门易学难精的武学，到了中后期突破一层往往需要花费不少的时间，就如同田大小姐一般，哪怕有丹药的帮助，也还是没能突破到五层。
content_en:
The larger the range of the Eye of Virtual Dimension, the more energy and spirit it collects, and the faster it collects dimension points. As long as there are enough dimension points, his strength will also grow rapidly.
Thinking about it, Yi Changsheng planned to upgrade the Eye of Virtual Dimension first, to at least 6 points. The omniscient viewing angle has a radius of six meters, and the maximum range is almost 18 meters.
In this way, the front yard of Tianjia Martial Arts School is within the range, and those warriors who have developed inner energy can be included, and the collection of dimension points will be faster.
Thinking about Yi Changsheng, he was full of motivation and lived a fulfilling life every day.
He first spent more than twenty days to increase the points of the Eye of Virtual Dimension to six points. Every time he added one point, the range increased, and the energy collected was faster. By six o'clock, it took almost four days to receive one point of dimension.
Then it took more than a month to fully improve the body-building boxing, and just like that, two months passed without realizing it.
He glanced at the information on the panel.
[Name: Yi Changsheng]
【Shouyuan: 1066】
[Talent: Eye of Virtual Dimension lv.1 (6100+)]
[Comprehension: 2]
[Spiritual Roots: Metal 9, Water 10, Wood 23, Fire 19, Earth 11, Space 28]
[Cultivation: Health Care Realm (1010)]
[Kung Fu: Healthy Fist (510+ for beginners)]
[Skill: Cooking (entry level 22100+)]
[Dimension points: 2]
The cultivation level of Yangshen Quan was finally completed, and the proficiency of the technique was still learned by Yi Changsheng on his own.
After all, he has learned so much martial arts knowledge from Qi Wancai, and his martial arts skills have also increased a lot. It is not difficult to master the simple health-preserving boxing techniques.
Yi Changqi's current blood is very abundant, and compared with Qi Wancai's, it is even stronger.
Calculating based on the panel points, Qi Wancai's cultivation level is about 8 points. Calculating based on Qi Wancai's current qualifications and progress, he estimates that it will take about a year of practice before he can master the health-preserving boxing.
It only took about three months for Yi Changsheng to go through time travel and practice Yangshengquan.
His martial arts qualifications should be pretty good, but no matter how good they are, he can master Yangshen Quan in three months, and all the credit goes to the dimensional point of the Eye of Virtual Dimension.
He couldn't help but sigh in his heart that the talent of the Eye of Virtual Reality was too powerful.
But once he thinks that this golden finger is his, it's okay. No matter how strong he is, he can accept it.
Now Yi Changsheng can faintly sense Qi and blood when practicing boxing, and even has the feeling of being able to grasp Qi and blood. In this case, it means that he can officially practice various powerful martial arts techniques.
Now he just needs to get started with the innate skills. The 2 dimension points he saved are just for the innate skills. Once the innate skills are entered into the panel, he can directly add points to improve them.
After these two months of study, Yi Changsheng could almost memorize the innate skills. In addition, he had previously observed the movement process of Miss Tian's body, and he believed that it would not be long before he could master the innate skills.
However, Xiantian Kung Fu is a martial art that is easy to learn but difficult to master. It often takes a lot of time to break through the first level in the middle and late stages. Just like Miss Tian, ​​even with the help of pills, she still failed to break through to the fifth level.
